subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as the public config API for tiered bootstrap context selection, with the PR's legacy no-override behavior and `minimal`/`standard`/`full` hook-extra semantics?
rationale: This adds a new prompt-context config surface that overlaps existing bootstrap/context controls, so code review can verify mechanics but cannot decide the long-term product contract alone.

options.title: Document and approve this API
options.body: Add the missing public docs and land this branch after maintainers accept the tier names, defaults, and hook-extra semantics.

options.title: Narrow or rename the API
options.body: Ask for a smaller or differently named config contract if the current tier meanings are too broad or confusing.

options.title: Pause for broader context design
options.body: Leave the linked proposal open and close or pause this PR if bootstrap tiering should be solved by a larger context-control design.

recommendation.title: Document and approve this API
recommendation.body: Add the missing public docs and land this branch after maintainers accept the tier names, defaults, and hook-extra semantics.
